before: Only justified paragraphs compressed East Asian punctuation to fit a line, and a lone trailing space could compress a line.
after: Legacy compatibility modes also fit left, centered, right, and right-to-left lines, with a half-advance admission limit and no compression of Korean text or marks (by language, or after Hangul on the line). Trailing spaces before a wrapping word never compress a line.
reason: Only derived line layout changes. Model ranges, operations, and serialized collaboration state stay the same.
